__baseline_prompt__.text: A photographic music-making scene in a compact home recording room at the blue edge of dawn. The person guided by the supplied reference portrait is seated at a wooden production desk, actively creating music. Her visible facial features and short dark bob with fine parted fringe follow the supplied portrait. She wears a soft charcoal knit top with loosely pushed sleeves; the warm pool from a desk lamp reveals a calm, absorbed face and the small inward smile of hearing a phrase settle into place. Her left fingertips hold down two adjacent white keys on a compact hardware synthesizer, while her right thumb and index finger turn one round filter knob on its top panel. Each wrist continues clearly to her own forearm; her elbows stay comfortably bent above the desk edge and she sits balanced on a low stool. The synthesizer sits directly in front of her. One audio cable runs across the clear tabletop from its output socket into the input socket of a small audio interface on the right, and a USB cable connects that interface to an open laptop behind it. The laptop display faces the musician and shows a multitrack audio arrangement with waveform lanes and a level meter, giving the held notes a visible recording context. A single small monitor speaker sits beside the laptop. Use a medium-wide three-quarter view from the open front corner of the desk, the camera just above seated eye level: her face, both hands, the played keys, the operated knob, both cable routes and their endpoints share readable space. Cool window light meets amber lamplight, with gentle skin texture, worn key edges and quiet room shadows. The mood is intimate concentration, a modest musical idea becoming tangible through connected hands and equipment.
